atoms.b: Linking adverbs sind Adverbien, die zwei Sätze ((++miteinander_verknüpfen voneinander_trennen)). Dadurch werden unter anderem Schlussfolgerungen, Ergänzungen, Bedingungen oder Vergleiche hergestellt.

atoms.b: Next week, I am going on a weekend trip to Edinburgh with my parents. ((++Incidentally Similarly)), I've planned everything from where to stay to what to see. We will walk through the streets of the Old Town. ((++Next Whereas)), we will visit the iconic Edinburgh Castle. ((++Finally All_in_all)), we will climb Arthur's Seat and enjoy the view of the astonishing city.
atoms.sound: Next week I will go on a weekend trip to Edinburgh with my parents. Incidentally, I've planned everything from where to stay to what to see. We will walk through the streets of the Old Town. Next, we will visit the iconic Edinburgh Castle. Finally, we will climb Arthur's Seat and enjoy the view of the astonishing city.

instruction.text: Ordne die Adverbien den passenden Kategorien zu.
Vervollständige die englischen Sätze, indem du das jeweils richtige Adverb auswählst.

atoms.b: She has put enough money aside. ((++Finally Otherwise)), she can afford a new jacket.
I don't have basketball practice in the evening. ((++As_a_result Besides)), I can hang out with my friends after school.
He has a lot of homework to do. ((++Consequently However)), he can't go to the skatepark today.
He loves painting pictures. ((++Similarly Instead)), his mum loves to draw.
I have a lot of chores to do. ((++Namely Furthermore)), tidying up my room, doing the laundry, and putting out the rubbish.
She really enjoys listening to music. ((++Therefore Still)), she never goes to school without her headphones.
